description: This file defines the 'SliceFixture' class used for setting up and managing integration testing environments. It provides helper methods for database context management, executing scoped services, and sending requests via MediatR within tests. The class facilitates creating an in-memory database, executing actions within a service scope, and cleaning up resources post-test.
